verdicts.reason: A keeps the original top-to-bottom order (sale ribbon, logo, can, headline, CTA), but the legal line has been blown up to near-body size and wedged tightly between headline and CTA, where it competes with both and crowds them; the ribbon and logo also fight each other across the top. B demotes the 'LONGEST DAY SALE' ribbon to a tiny strip below the CTA, so the offer comes last in reading order, enlarges the legal copy into a prominent paragraph, and parks the can low-left on top of the planet with dead space above it, which leaves the layout lopsided.
